title: Fractions and Decimals Worksheets: Tenths and Hundredths
intro: Connect tenths, hundredths, and decimals with a hundred grid.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Shade tenths as complete columns, then count the same amount in hundredths. Match both fraction forms to decimal notation.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

7/100 = 0.07
70/100 = 0.70

Seven hundredths and seventy hundredths are different amounts. In 0.07, the zero keeps the tenths place empty so the seven stays in the hundredths place.

Ask your student

How many hundredths have the same value as one tenth?

If your student needs help

If the student writes 0.7 for seven hundredths, use the chart to show the empty tenths place.

Choosing and using the worksheet

Each sheet has two fraction-to-decimal questions, two decimal-to-hundredths questions, and two tenths-to-hundredths questions. Hundredths numerators range from 1 to 99; tenths numerators range from 2 to 9. The original decimal forms keep two places.
